title: Configuration-Type Envy (Interest Rate Lookup)
pattern: A class method computes a value using parameters passed to it, but retrieves its core factor or multiplier exclusively by reaching into an associated configuration/type object.
why_bad: The method "envies" the configuration/type object because the calculation's constants or rates belong to the classification category itself.
detection: A method that performs math where the only class-scoped field accessed is an associated struct's property.
counterexample: Methods that require the host class's own state (e.g., active balances or transaction history) to complete the calculation.
